{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = data[data.duplicated(subset='patient_id', keep=False)]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_count}')

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate patient to see if there are multiple entries
sample_seq_summary = duplicate_patients.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Max sample_seq per duplicate patient:
{sample_seq_summary}')"}
